WITNIS_DB.description: Absolute path to the SQLite index. Optional. Defaults to .witnis/index.sqlite in the working directory. Call the index tool first in a new repo.

listing.name: Witnis
listing.short: Evidence envelopes for agent change: blast-radius, PR gate, gated verify.
listing.long: Local-first engineering witness for AI coding agents (search witnis-dev). Index a repo into SQLite, then use index / look / impact / verify. verify does nothing until WITNIS_ALLOW_VERIFY=1 and execute=true; blocked means 0 commands ran. Pair with Harnis as a stdio seatbelt — not an OS sandbox. Not affiliated with Witnis AB / witnis.se.
